## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` is green (ruff check + format + pytest)
- [ ] Coverage stays at 100% on the shipped surface (a new `strat_*` in `omit`
      lands with a golden-output test in the same commit)
- [ ] Conventional-commit title (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `refactor:` / `test:` / `chore:`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for anything user-visible
